title: Fictional source-to-target G/L mapping restoration playbook
provenance: Generated draft for a synthetic demonstration. These are candidate human procedures pending approval of this exact version; they are not real SAP instructions or an enacted correction.
applicability: Exactly one supported missing applicable G/L mapping cause.
A completed exact-scope failure-time mapping query returned no row.
A separately identified and authenticated approved target-design reference establishes the intended target.
Both target chart account and company extension already exist and are unblocked.

evidence_checks.requirement: Match source document/target context and preserved failure-time attempt.
Cite a completed exact-scope mapping query with zero returned rows.
Cite the distinct approved independent target-design record, matching source/account/company/interface/date.
Both required chart account and company extension exist and are unblocked at failure time.
Retain contradictions and additional blockers rather than guessing a single cause.

prerequisites_and_approvals.requirement: Actual authorised humans approve the exact independent target-reference and mapping playbook versions; approval is not inferred from the absence query.
Assigned owner or process owner explicitly reviews cause and evidence. Recording readable wording alone does not confirm the cause.
The acting human supplies target-change authority and the approved account attributes/company settings. Approval is not inferred from this playbook.
An actual authenticated actor is associated with the demo owner role and a designated validator role; audit actual actor and acting role.

candidate_human_actions.description: Review the preserved failure, complete mapping absence audit, distinct independent target-design record and existing target-master components; record actual human findings or missing checks.

After explicit approval and change authority, simulate creating the approved applicable source-to-target mapping. Preserve the existing target master account and company extension. Record exact scope, performer/time and stored correction proof.

After correction confirmation, the human simulates a new ordered reprocessing attempt for the same document/target context and stores the result proof and target reference. A failed result does not qualify.

The designated validator compares expected and observed currency, amounts, company, mapped line accounts and source-to-target reference for the latest successful attempt; record discrepancies or Passed with stored proof.
Capture confirmed cause or honest unresolved gaps, correction, scope/limitations, outcome/proof, resolver/time. Reuse starts Pending review independently of operational resolution.

verification_checks.description: Source and target document currency match.
Each debit/credit and totals match the source and applicable approved mapping; do not infer success from balanced totals alone.
Target company matches the replication context.
Each target account matches the approved source-to-target mapping and required extension exists.
Target posting contains the correct source system/client/company/year/document and interface relationship.
Validation/proof links refer to the latest applicable successful attempt with known processing order, not the earlier failed attempt.

escalation.condition: Mapping unavailable, pending, conflicting, expired or withdrawn
escalation.action: Keep cause Needs review until the intended target is established; do not create a guessed account.

escalation.condition: Guidance unavailable, pending, conflicting, expired or withdrawn
escalation.action: Withhold actionable Agent 3 brief and record the guidance gap.
Block correction with the unmet prerequisites visible.

escalation.condition: Several blockers, ambiguous attempt order or no configured owner
escalation.action: Coordinate human investigation or assignment. Missing ownership alone does not suppress otherwise eligible guidance.
Retain proof and return to active investigation through an audited human action; do not mark Resolved.

limitations: Fictional POC scope only; no customer approval, SAP transaction code, release-specific configuration, or write tool is supplied.
AI may read evidence and draft eligible guidance; only humans simulate correction, reprocessing, validation and approval.
No history seed is approved for retrieval by this generated pack.
